    "Model forecasts overshoot price by 0.3-0.5 on first day, correcting within 2 days",

    "Sentiment turning negative (negative values) causes faster price decline than model anticipates",
    "Model lacks momentum capture - underestimates persistence of price trends",
    "When price is below 70, true outcomes are 2-3 EUR higher than model for first 10+ days",
    "Model variance is 30-40% lower than true outcome variance (model is too smooth)",
    "Sentiment strength correlates with forecast accuracy - weak sentiment (0.3-0.67) areas have 40% more errors"
